records.command: Get-Content .dip-local/current-host-qa.json; Get-Content .dip-local/app-server-schema/v2/ThreadStartParams.json | Select-Object -First 95; rg -n 'collaborationMode|CollaborationMode|reasoningEffort|approvalPolicy' .dip-local/app-server-schema/v2/TurnStartParams.json; rg -n 'trust|hook' "$env:USERPROFILE/.codex/config.toml" "$env:USERPROFILE/.codex/hooks.json" | Select-Object -First 24; rg -n 'skill|current intent workflow' src/repository-integration.js; rg -n '"task claim"' src/cli-help.js

node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; for (const file of ["src/core.js","src/repository-integration.js"]) {let text=fs.readFileSync(file,"utf8"); const needle=file.includes("core") ? "Claim a task before development using the hook actor/session;" : "Read the project AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md for the current intent workflow."; const addition=file.includes("core") ? "For reviewed development, task_prepare combines a small intent patch, ownership and compact criteria in one call using hook actor/session. Avoid rereading unchanged context already supplied by the hook or receipt. Use task_update while planning; future ideas stay unclaimed. Claim a task before development using the hook actor/session;" : "Read the project AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md for the current intent workflow. When starting reviewed development, task_prepare refines the captured task, claims scope and returns compact criteria in one call with hook actor/session. Avoid rereading unchanged context supplied by the hook or receipt; planning and future ideas use task_update without claiming."; if(!text.includes(needle)) throw Error(file); fs.writeFileSync(file,text.replace(needle,addition));} let t=fs.readFileSync("src/workflow.js","utf8"); fs.writeFileSync("src/workflow.js",t.replace("update|adopt|finish|plan","update|prepare|adopt|finish|plan"));'
